gen-press-start-2p-gf-stack-sans-headlin: Stack Sans Headline reads like blueprint lettering, one constant line with wide gaps that hold up even when tiny. Press Start 2P sits above it with chunky pixel-game spacing, so the page feels playful on top and drafted below.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-sono: A splayed c terminal and tube-like strokes give Tilt Neon its glow-sign swagger, with short ascenders under a big x-height. And Sono answers with tall, widely spaced lowercase, its a left ajar, so the whole pairing feels loud above and spacious below.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-stack-sans-notch: Unica One draws a very large lowercase eye with visible daylight inside every curve, all at one thickness. But Stack Sans Notch is the one to trust for body text, with rod-stock strokes and open curves in big-bodied words.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-stack-sans-text: Stack Sans Text reads like a marker line, with curve endings kept well apart and big-bodied lowercase. And Wallpoet can go larger above it, since its high-rising letters and paper-through-the-line gaps carry the weight.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-sulphur-point: Warnes tapers its ink strokes before they touch. Its stretched, spacious tracking and total lack of stroke contrast sit against Sulphur Point, whose bulky lowercase and distinct open gaps in c, e, s, and a make the strongest quality here a loud, sturdy friendliness.
gen-irish-grover-gf-tiktok-sans: Tall lowercase makes Irish Grover words look sturdy and large, with softly varied strokes that sit between monoline and sharp contrast. TikTok Sans handles the quieter work, its x-height rising close to cap height and its c opening spaciously.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-ubuntu-sans: Luckiest Guy pours its ink at one width under a high mean line, with an e whose eye opens clearly to the right. Ubuntu Sans does the calmer job, its tubular strokes like bent copper pipe and big lowercase eyes keeping the text friendly.
gen-megrim-gf-vend-sans: Vend Sans draws a ruler-straight line with wide, unclosed curve ends. Next to Megrim's angular, measured strokes and its open, paperclip-like c, the strongest quality is a shared precision with different attitudes.
gen-righteous-fs-bespoke-sans: Commanding bowls that fill the line give Righteous the look of thin steel rod bent into letters, and it has the high lowercase to make headlines hit. Bespoke Sans does the refined work, with moderate lowercase height and generous space between its curve ends and the stem.
gen-righteous-gf-abeezee: Fun, commanding bowls fill the line in Righteous, like thin steel rod bent into letters, while ABeeZee keeps its terminals well clear of the stem. Neon-glass thickness meets a high mean line.
